item.summary: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) released the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) monthly report for September, 2026, which provides a detailed analysis of types and categories of public grievances and the nature of disposal. This is the 53 rd report on Central Ministries/Departments published by DARPG.
item.title: DARPG releases the 53rd Monthly Report on Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) for Central Ministries/ Departments performance for the month of September, 2026
